scenes.title: Durham University — Fluid Mechanics — 2 m Wind Tunnel Fixed-Ground Test Section
scenes.institution: Durham University — Fluid Mechanics — 2 m Wind Tunnel Fixed-Ground Test Section
scenes.reference_notes: Open-jet vehicle test section: dark nozzle behind the retained model car, raised test floor, overhead supports, pale walls, yellow side structure and a nearby observation window. The fixed-ground turntable and probe traverse are described by the facility page. Dry fixed-ground mechanical configuration. No airflow, turbulence, aerodynamic force, PIV, infrared data, rolling-road belt or full wind-tunnel return duct. The reference vehicle photograph establishes the bay; the published fixed-ground configuration supplies turntable dimensions.
